name: cleanroom_r2e_top2000_difficulty_router_v1

gate.feature_definition: maximum Tanimoto similarity from the query reaction to train reactions using only the binary 2048-d DRFP block; no benchmark label is used
gate.decision: use residual scale 0.03 iff max_train_drfp_tanimoto >= 0.9; otherwise use exact coarse scale 0
gate.threshold_selection: conservative train-only development choice from folds 0/1/2: the >=0.9 region was the only broad slice with consistent strong gains across all three folds; no fold3 or outer metric was used to choose this threshold

confirmation_split.split_type: strict protein+reaction entity-disjoint deterministic salted hash double-cold

confirmation_pass_rule: On the single frozen salted confirmation cell, the routed model must improve MRR, MAP, NDCG@10 and Hit@10 relative to exact coarse ranking, with no regression in Hit@20 or Hit@50. No alternative gate threshold, split salt, fold or residual scale may be substituted after reveal.
outer_policy: This is an internal router confirmation only. External/outer reranker routing remains forbidden until this frozen salted confirmation passes.
